00012 !
00013 !  Description: This is a subroutine to "merge" species and reaction files into a
00014 !               three dimensional array that the main program can use to determine
00015 !               whether two species react or not. It also generates an array that
00016 !               correlates a species' name with its number. Finally, it creates a
00017 !               two dimensional array that lists the Ed,Eb, and Eb2 (Chang & Herbst 2014)
00018 !               values for each surface species.
00019 !

00035 SUBROUTINE qbert()
00036   USE subroutines
00037   USE parameters
00038   IMPLICIT NONE
00039   ! Input and output
00040   INTEGER                          :: ierror1, ierror2
00041   INTEGER                          :: n, k, n1, n3
00042   INTEGER                          :: prod, i, j
00043   INTEGER                          :: i_count
00044   INTEGER                          :: ion_num
00045   INTEGER                          :: spec_header_num, reac_header_num
00046   INTEGER                          :: species_count
00047   INTEGER            , ALLOCATABLE :: ion_temp(:)
00048   CHARACTER(LEN=10)                :: tempName
00049   CHARACTER(LEN=10)                :: line
00050   CHARACTER(LEN=10)  , ALLOCATABLE :: r_array(:,:)
00051 
00052   ! Open files
00053   OPEN (UNIT=1,FILE=SPECIES_FILE  ,STATUS='OLD',ACTION='READ',IOSTAT=ierror1)
00054   OPEN (UNIT=2,FILE=REACTIONS_FILE,STATUS='OLD',ACTION='READ',IOSTAT=ierror2)
00055 
00056   fileopen: IF ( ierror1 .EQ. 0 .AND. ierror2 .EQ. 0 ) THEN
00057      ! Read the species and reactions file header line numbers
00058      CALL linecount(1,ierror1,NUM_SPECIES,spec_header_num)
00059      CALL linecount(2,ierror2,NUM_REACTS,reac_header_num)
00060 
00061      ALLOCATE( REACT_CUBE(NUM_SPECIES,NUM_SPECIES,3), &
00062           SP_LIST(NUM_SPECIES),&
00063           EN_LIST(NUM_SPECIES), &
00064           IONLIST(ions) )
00065      ALLOCATE( ion_temp(NUM_SPECIES) )
00066      ALLOCATE( r_array(NUM_REACTS,5) )
00067 
00068      ! Initialize global values
00069      REACT_CUBE =  0
00070      EN_LIST    =  0
00071      IONLIST    =  0
00072      SP_LIST    = "0"
00073 
00074      ! Initialize local values
00075      ion_temp      =  0
00076      ion_num       =  0
00077      species_count =  0
00078      line          = '0'
00079      r_array       = '0'
00080 
00081      ! Read the contents of the species file and create the SP_LIST and energy_list
00082      DO n=1,NUM_SPECIES
00083         READ (1,*,IOSTAT=ierror1) line
00084         IF ( line(1:1) .NE. "!" ) THEN
00085            species_count = species_count + 1
00086            BACKSPACE (UNIT=1,IOSTAT=ierror1)
00087            READ(1,*,IOSTAT=ierror1) SP_LIST(species_count), EN_LIST(species_count)
00088            tempName = TRIM(SP_LIST(species_count))
00089            SP_LIST(species_count) = tempName
00090            ! Tally up the total number of anions and cations
00091            IF ( (tempName(LEN(TRIM(tempName)):LEN(TRIM(tempName))) .EQ. '-') .OR. &
00092                 (tempName(LEN(TRIM(tempName)):LEN(TRIM(tempName))) .EQ. '+')) THEN
00093               IF ( tempName(1:1) .NE. '*') THEN 
00094                 ion_num = ion_num + 2
00095                 ion_temp(species_count) = species_count
00096               END IF
00097            END IF
00098         ELSE
00099            CONTINUE
00100         END IF
00101         IF ( ierror1 .NE. 0 ) STOP "Error reading species file."
00102      END DO
00103 
00104      ! Lookup to numbers of CRP and electron in the listj
00105      CALL lookup( "CRP", NUM_SPECIES, SP_LIST,  CRPNUM)
00106      CALL lookup( '*'  , NUM_SPECIES, SP_LIST,  EXCNUM )
00107      CALL lookup( 'e'  , NUM_SPECIES, SP_LIST,  ELECNUM )
00108      SPECIAL_LIST = (/ CRPNUM, EXCNUM, ELECNUM /)     
00109 
00110      i_count = 1
00111      DO n=1,NUM_SPECIES
00112         IF (ion_temp(n) .NE. 0 ) THEN
00113            IONLIST(i_count) = ion_temp(n)
00114            i_count = i_count + 1
00115         ELSE
00116            CONTINUE
00117         END IF
00118      END DO
00119 
00120      ! Read the contents of the reactions file and make the reactionCube
00121      qubemake: DO n1=1,NUM_REACTS
00122         READ(2,*,IOSTAT=ierror2) line
00123         IF ( line(1:1) .NE. "!" ) THEN
00124            BACKSPACE (UNIT=2,IOSTAT=ierror2)
00125            READ(2,*,IOSTAT=ierror2) r_array(n1,1), r_array(n1,2), r_array(n1,3), &
00126                 r_array(n1,4), r_array(n1,5)
00127            CALL lookup(TRIM(r_array(n1,1)),NUM_SPECIES,SP_LIST,i)
00128            CALL lookup(TRIM(r_array(n1,2)),NUM_SPECIES,SP_LIST,j)
00129            k=0
00130            DO n3=3,5
00131               k = k + 1
00132               IF ( r_array(n1,n3) .NE. '0' ) THEN
00133                  CALL lookup(r_array(n1,n3),NUM_SPECIES,SP_LIST,prod)
00134                   REACT_CUBE(i,j,k) = prod
00135                  REACT_CUBE(j,i,k) = prod
00136               ELSE
00137                  CONTINUE
00138               END IF
00139            END DO
00140         ELSE
00141            CONTINUE
00142         END IF
00143      END DO qubemake
00144   ELSE fileopen
00145      IF ( ierror1 .NE. 0 .AND. ierror2 .NE. 0 ) THEN
00146         PRINT *, 'Could not open any of the input files'
00147      ELSE IF ( ierror1 .NE. 0 .AND. ierror2 .EQ. 0 ) THEN
00148         PRINT *, 'Could not open: ', species_file
00149      ELSE
00150         PRINT *, 'Could not open: ', reactions_file
00151      END IF
00152   END IF fileopen
00153 END SUBROUTINE qbert

00155 SUBROUTINE sort_energies( prods, A_en, B_en, C_en )
00156   USE parameters
00157   IMPLICIT NONE
00158   INTEGER, INTENT(INOUT), DIMENSION(3) :: prods
00159   INTEGER               , DIMENSION(3) :: temp
00160   REAL               , INTENT(IN)                  :: A_en, B_en, C_en
00161 
00162   IF ( A_en .GT. B_en ) THEN
00163      IF ( A_en .GT. C_en ) THEN
00164         IF ( B_en .GT. C_en ) THEN
00165            ! A > B > C
00166            temp(1) = prods(1)
00167            temp(2) = prods(2)
00168            temp(3) = prods(3)
00169         ELSE
00170            ! A > C > B
00171            temp(1) = prods(1)
00172            temp(2) = prods(3)
00173            temp(3) = prods(2)
00174         END IF
00175      ELSE
00176         ! C > A > B
00177         temp(1) = prods(3)
00178         temp(2) = prods(1)
00179         temp(3) = prods(2)
00180      END IF
00181   ELSE
00182      IF ( B_en .GT. C_en ) THEN
00183         IF ( A_en .GT. C_en ) THEN
00184            ! B > A > C
00185            temp(1) = prods(2)
00186            temp(2) = prods(1)
00187            temp(3) = prods(3)
00188         ELSE
00189            ! B > C > A
00190            temp(1) = prods(2)
00191            temp(2) = prods(3)
00192            temp(3) = prods(1)
00193         END IF
00194      ELSE
00195         ! C > B > A
00196         temp(1) = prods(3)
00197         temp(2) = prods(2)
00198         temp(3) = prods(1)
00199      END IF
00200   END IF
00201 
00202   prods = temp
00203 
00204 END SUBROUTINE sort_energies
